phase: Monetary Policy Reaction Function — Measurement Source Screening
purpose: Determine whether Romania has exact, frequency-compatible and semantically defensible inflation-gap, activity-gap and expectations observables for a policy reaction function without converting qualitative survey balances or model-based gaps into observed shocks.

inflation_target.role: Allows an observed inflation-target midpoint for an inflation-gap measurement contract.

consumer_price_expectations.institution: European Commission DG ECFIN / Eurostat BCS
consumer_price_expectations.concept: Consumer qualitative balance: price trends over the next 12 months
consumer_price_expectations.semantic_limit: A balance of survey responses is not an expected annual inflation rate in percentage points and cannot be subtracted from the BNR target as if units matched.
consumer_price_expectations.romania_revision_note: Romania consumer survey publication resumed in April 2024; consistent monthly/quarterly balances were restored using new data from May 2023 and econometric techniques. Disaggregate category/share results were not restored consistently.

financial_analyst_expectations.evidence: BNR research/Inflation Reports document 1-year and 2-year-ahead financial-analyst inflation expectations historically.
financial_analyst_expectations.semantic_limit: Charts/research evidence does not constitute a current immutable machine-readable expectations vintage.

bnr_inflation_forecast.semantic_limit: Central-bank forecast is part of the policy information set/model and is not interchangeable with private-sector expectations; using it in a policy rule would require explicit simultaneity/model-consistency treatment.

activity_gap_ameco.dataset: AMECO potential-output related variables including AVGDGP/OVGDP
activity_gap_ameco.semantic_limit: Annual model-based output gap is not a quarterly observed activity gap and may be revised with forecast vintages.

activity_gap_bnr.concept: GDP/aggregate-demand gap used in Inflation Reports
activity_gap_bnr.semantic_limit: A model-based gap may be scientifically useful but requires a retained vintage and explicit real-time/revision treatment before policy-rule estimation.

prohibited_shortcuts: Do not interpret the CONS_006 qualitative balance as percentage inflation expectations.
Do not use BNR staff inflation forecasts as private expectations without an explicit structural information-set contract.
Do not interpolate annual AMECO output gaps to quarters and call them observed quarterly gaps.
Do not estimate a Taylor-type rule on full-sample revised gaps without real-time-vintage treatment.
Do not treat observed exchange-rate movements as exogenous policy-rule regressors in a managed-float regime.
Do not activate the monetary-credit feedback merely because target and policy-rate histories are observed.
reopen_trigger: Retain a machine-readable quantitative expectations series or preregister a qualitative-expectations candidate family with compatible units; retain quarterly activity-gap vintages with revision timing; freeze policy-regime/intervention and simultaneity identification before any reaction-function fit.
